title: Presenting an original grocery sign
titleZh: 展示雜貨店的原版招牌
passage: Good morning, volunteers. The sign in the case is the original from Lyle’s grocery. We cleaned it for this show, but we haven’t added paint. We want people to see what the cleaning revealed, not just a guess at how the sign once looked. The old photograph beside the projector was sharp enough to recover the outline of the large letters, but not the thinner details. It was printed in black and white. There’s a blue patch underneath a bracket on the original. That’s where the projection’s blue came from, although we can’t date the patch. Some visitors read from the bench. The large-print card on it gives only the main points, not the entire captions. Enlarged copies of the full captions are in the drawer by the table. You can take a copy to anyone who wants to stay seated. Back at the big table, one photo shows the uncleaned sign, and the other shows it halfway through cleaning. The narrow stripe next to the letters first became visible in that second photo. It isn’t on the projection.
passageZh: 各位志工早安。展示櫃裡的招牌，是萊爾雜貨店原本的那一塊。這次展出前，我們清潔過招牌，但沒有加上任何新漆。我們希望讓訪客看到清潔過程中發現了什麼，而不只是看我們猜測它以前長什麼樣子。投影旁的舊照片夠清楚，可以還原大字母的輪廓，但看不出較細的細節。那是一張黑白照片。原招牌有一個支架，底下有一小塊藍漆。投影上的藍色就是根據這塊藍漆選定的，但我們不知道它是什麼時候漆上去的。有些訪客坐在長椅上閱讀。長椅上的大字版卡片只列重點，不是完整的展品說明。大桌旁的抽屜有完整說明的放大版。如果有人想坐著看，可以拿一份給他。回到大桌那裡，一張照片拍的是招牌還沒清潔時的樣子，另一張則拍到清潔進行到一半的樣子。字母旁邊的細條紋，是到第二張照片才第一次看得見。投影上沒有那道條紋。
